dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge extending from the dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Consistent convex arc radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak projection with a high pixel thickness-to-length ratio relative to the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum dorsal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white linear mark/scar on the superior portion of the dorsal fin's leading edge; secondary small elliptical mark on the lower mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced polygonal mesh artifacts on the ventral and caudal boundaries indicating a low-resolution digital model.
